overview: Shar Vahl is the Vah Shir capital city, rebuilt and expanded after the Terror of Luclin era. It blends tribal tradition with civic organization and arcane infrastructure.
history: Shar Vahl was founded after the Vah Shir were transported to Luclin.
The city expanded around the Royal District and Hunter’s Quarter.
Civic guilds formed to manage trade, crafting, and city operations.
Arcane Sanctum was established to study Luclin’s planar anomalies.
Shar Vahl Reborn introduced new districts, terraces, and ramparts.
regionHooks: A royal decree calls for hunters to investigate thicket corruption.
Arcane Sanctum detects planar anomalies beneath the city.
Civic guilds request aid with supply disruptions.
Shadow‑Threat Watch reports Grimling infiltrators near the ramparts.
